Game Overview

Funny Daycare is a dress up game built around experience the whimsical joy of nurturing lovable animal friends in a vibrant world. As a dedicated babysitter, you'll feed, bathe, and dress up these furry pals in charming outfits. Dive into delightful mini-games, unlock surprises, and creatively manage their needs for endless fun and cuddles.
